name: Hosts Config Rule
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts an AWS Config rule (footprint -> rule): a rule config:DescribeConfigRules returned, called with no names or filters (every rule, service-linked ones included). Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, and the reader records that footprint's account_region.config_rules surface under the per-region rules. One edge type per listed type: see tap_plugin.aws_core.regional. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
